newsitem.title: JAPAN: All Japanese hostages freed in Lima-Hashimoto.
newsitem.headline: All Japanese hostages freed in Lima-Hashimoto.

text.p: All 24 Japanese hostages were rescued from the Lima residence of the Japanese ambassador to Peru when it was stormed by troops, Japanese Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto said on Wednesday.
"Some are injured but all Japanese hostages have been rescued," Hashimoto told a news conference.
"We unfortunately were not told of the operation before the move but we thank the Peruvian authorities," Hashimoto said.
Hashimoto added he had talked to Japanese ambassador to Peru Morihisa Aoki, one of the freed hostages, on the telephone.
